-Issues may arise if you have any other mods installed that LOAD the same files. [/font]

This is a [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] BASE mod that uses LOAD image commands, not EDIT image commands. This is intended as a mod to replace EVERYONE that is a man in Stardew Valley (other than the player) so because I am replacing so much on each image sheet, I just replaced the whole sheet. That means that any other mods that replace the same files with the LOAD command instead of the EDIT command inside content patcher will not work properly with this mod. Only one mod can use the LOAD function per xnb file. EDIT changes things inside an image in a certain range of pixels determined by the mod author. LOAD replaces the entire image.

If you aren’t seeing something in game that you expect to, check to make sure that you don’t have another mod that REPLACES or EDITS the same xnb file. [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11112?tab=images]This mod’s images[/url] show charts of each character replaced. These are accompanied by the name of the xnb file. Use those names to determine if another mod is replacing that same xnb file. If the other mod author isn’t replacing a huge amount of stuff like I am, then they shouldn’t have used the LOAD image command and you should be okay to use both and have them all work. LOAD commands happen first, then EDIT comes after, so the final thing displayed in game will be the product of the EDIT command.
[/size]
[size=3][i][b][color=#f1c232]For Example:[/color][/b][/i][/size][size=2]If you have [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11112]Feminizer[/url][size=2] and [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10644]Animated Inventory Tabs[/url][size=2] installed, Feminizer LOADS and replaces the entire cursors.xnb first, and then [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10644]Animated Inventory Tabs[/url][size=2] EDITS a particular set of pixels to animate the inventory tabs.[/size]
